name: Azure Boards
description: Azure DevOps work items (Azure Boards). Each Azure DevOps project is a collection. Restrict the connection to some projects in the settings.

settings.label: Organization
settings.description: The organization name or URL, for example "contoso" or "https://dev.azure.com/contoso".

settings.label: Personal access token
settings.description: A personal access token with the scope "Work Items (Read & write)". In Azure DevOps, open User settings > Personal access tokens.

settings.label: Area path
settings.description: Optional. Show only the work items in this area and its child areas, for example "Contoso\Web".
